parts.gloss: that which will be lost, and

words.gloss: that which will be lost, and

parts.gloss: that which will be gained, and

words.gloss: that which will be gained, and

literal: That which will be lost, and that which will be gained, and the profit that will yield in the future, having pondered, one should act.
translation: Weigh the loss, the gain, and the ultimate profit that will follow in the future, and then undertake the action.
modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்யும்போது அதனால் அழியும் பொருள், உண்டாகும் பொருள், பின்னர் அது தரும் லாபம் ஆகியவற்றை ஆராய்ந்து செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: Before undertaking any action, one must carefully calculate three things: the immediate loss or expenditure involved (அழிவதூஉம்), the immediate gain or result (ஆவதூஉம்), and the lasting benefit or profit that will accrue in the long run (வழிபயக்கும் ஊதியமும்). Only after thoroughly deliberating on these three aspects should one proceed with the task. This ensures that the effort is not wasted and leads to sustainable success.
